notes: The saying is the Imam's written reply («فكتب إلي»): a rescript from an Imam, a case rule 11 leaves to a ruling
«عن أخيه علي بن مهزيار» is one link by rule 7
«كتبت إلى أبي الحسن» names the Imam after the chain: imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); «ع» is left out
«حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي» names the compiler's father only by relation
